type A = { b?: { c?: string; f?: () => string; d?: Box } } | undefined;
class Box {
  v = 7;
}
function isText(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === "string";
}
function truthy(a: A): void {
  if (a?.b?.c) console.log(a.b.c.toUpperCase());
  if (!a?.b?.c) return;
  console.log(a.b.c.length);
}
function equality(a: A): void {
  if (a?.b?.c !== undefined) console.log(a.b.c.toUpperCase());
  if (a?.b?.c === "x") console.log(a.b.c.toUpperCase());
  if (a?.b?.c != null) console.log(a.b.c.toUpperCase());
  if (a?.b?.c === undefined) return;
  console.log(a.b.c.length);
}
function others(a: A): void {
  if (typeof a?.b?.c === "string") console.log(a.b.c.toUpperCase());
  if (typeof a?.b?.c !== "undefined") console.log(a.b.c.toUpperCase());
  if (a?.b?.f?.()) console.log(a.b.f());
  if (a?.b?.d instanceof Box) console.log(a.b.d.v);
  if (isText(a?.b?.c)) console.log(a.b.c.toUpperCase());
}
function links(p: { b: { c?: string } | undefined } | undefined, q: { b?: { c: { d?: string } } } | undefined, r: { b?: { c?: string[] } } | undefined): void {
  if (p?.b!.c) console.log(p.b.c.toUpperCase());
  if (q?.b?.c.d) console.log(q.b.c.d.toUpperCase());
  if (r?.b?.c?.[0]) console.log(r.b.c[0].toUpperCase());
}
truthy({ b: { c: "x" } });
truthy(undefined);
equality({ b: { c: "x" } });
others({ b: { c: "y", f: () => "f", d: new Box() } });
links({ b: { c: "p" } }, { b: { c: { d: "q" } } }, { b: { c: ["r"] } });
